correctness.rationale: In P_n=C_n box K_2 and twisted M_n (n>=3), proper three-colour rung pairs (x,y) have only three possible next pairs (y,x),(y,z),(z,x) with third colour z. The swapped case forces an illegal equal-colour following rung by 2-dynamic neighbor conditions; the other cases propagate one of exactly two disjoint orientation-preserving period-three cycles. Thus straight closure requires 3|n and yields exactly 6 initial ordered pairs times 2 orientation=12 named three-colour solutions; twisted closure requires the reversed ordered pair, impossible. Four-colour column recipes handle three residue classes for both closures and give sharp chi_2. Independent brute-force enumeration directly over 3-colour assignments checked 12 graph/circumference instances n=3..8 and confirmed 12-or-zero, including K_3,3 boundary; finite checks supplement structural proof.
